title: Concept: Cargo dependency resolved from a local path
description: Cargo.toml declares a dependency that points at a directory on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the artifact is not reproducible from the manifest.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the artifact is not reproducible from the manifest.
